tools.name: list_assessments
tools.title: List DPIA assessments
tools.description: List the signed-in user's DPIA / AI risk assessments with status, risk score, and risk level.

status.description: Optional status filter, e.g. draft, in_review, completed.

limit.description: Maximum number of assessments to return (default 25).

tools.name: get_assessment
tools.title: Get DPIA assessment
tools.description: Fetch one DPIA assessment in full, including processing details, data categories, legal basis, and the stored risk/threat details payload.

id.description: Assessment UUID, or the human-readable display id (e.g. DPIA-001).

tools.name: create_assessment
tools.title: Create DPIA assessment
tools.description: Create a new DPIA / AI risk assessment for the signed-in user. Use for intake; refine details later in the Priveria wizard.

name.description: Name of the system or processing activity.

category.description: Assessment category, e.g. AI System, Vendor, Product.

processing_purpose.description: Why the personal data is processed.

legal_basis.description: GDPR legal basis, e.g. Consent, Legitimate Interests.

risk_level.description: Initial risk level: low, medium, high, or critical.

tools.name: list_vendors
tools.title: List third-party vendors
tools.description: List the signed-in user's third-party vendors with risk level, compliance status, jurisdiction, and certifications.

risk_level.description: Optional risk level filter: low, medium, high, critical.

limit.description: Maximum number of vendors to return (default 25).

tools.name: summarize_risk_posture
tools.title: Summarize privacy risk posture
tools.description: Aggregate the signed-in user's assessments and vendors into a portfolio risk snapshot: counts by status, risk level, average risk score, and high-risk items needing attention.

tools.name: list_policy_mappings
tools.title: List policy mappings and safeguards
tools.description: List the policy mappings, safeguards, and control rationales derived for a DPIA assessment — from the risk register, LINDDUN and MAESTRO threats, and the processing/safeguard controls — with regulatory references and coverage gaps.

id.description: Assessment UUID or display id (e.g. DPIA-001).

source.description: Filter mappings by origin. Defaults to all.

unmitigated_only.description: Return only mappings that currently have no safeguard recorded.

tools.name: sync_assessment_to_onetrust
tools.title: Sync assessment to OneTrust
tools.description: Trigger the OneTrust GRC integration for one DPIA assessment. Maps the Priveria assessment onto the OneTrust DPIA/processing-activity schema, pushes it when OneTrust credentials are configured, and returns sync status plus the field mapping results. Use dry_run to preview the mapping without calling OneTrust.

assessment_id.description: Assessment UUID or human-readable display id (e.g. DPIA-001) to sync.

dry_run.description: When true, only compute and return the mapping without pushing to OneTrust.
